learning_outcomes.text: The student can independently read/search, understand and apply documentation (schematics, datasheets, programming manuals, ...).
The student knows and can apply the formulas and concepts related to Ohm's law, Power, PWM.
The student is able to troubleshoot a mixed design (software and hardware).
The student can use a microcontroller to capture input from a user or their environment and build practical applications from it.

assessment_rules: During the semester, the student takes a written test on the theory presented, which accounts for 50% of the grade. The student works on a project during the course series, partly under the guidance of the lecturer. In the final weeks of the semester, students present and defend their projects. The student also writes a report for their project, which counts for 50% of the grade. For resits, there is a written test in the third examination period (50%) and a project meeting the same requirements as in the first sitting (50%). No partial transfers are allowed for this course.
